mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_student (teacher_id, student_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{studentId}, #{primary})
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM students s JOIN teacher_student ts ON ts.student_id = s.id WHERE ts.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND s.active = TRUE ORDER BY s.full_name

SELECT ts.id, ts.teacher_id AS user_id, ts.student_id, ts.is_primary, ts.assigned_at, u.full_name AS user_name, 'TEACHER' AS user_role FROM teacher_student ts JOIN users u ON u.id = ts.teacher_id WHERE ts.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY u.full_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_student WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parent_student (parent_id, student_id, relationship) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{studentId}, #{relationship})
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM students s JOIN parent_student ps ON ps.student_id = s.id WHERE ps.parent_id = #{parentId} AND s.active = TRUE ORDER BY s.full_name

SELECT ps.id, ps.parent_id AS user_id, ps.student_id, ps.relationship, ps.assigned_at, u.full_name AS user_name, 'PARENT' AS user_role FROM parent_student ps JOIN users u ON u.id = ps.parent_id WHERE ps.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY u.full_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parent_student WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT teacher_id FROM teacher_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
